issues.title: In-place filter and tab interactions reset document scroll to the top
issues.evidence: Measured in Chromium at 1440x860. Clicking a filter with no URL change moved scrollY from 700 to 0 on /speaking, /market, /exams and from 604/700 to 0 on /reading, /listening; Arena stake selection moved 500 to 0. Browser clamping was ruled out: on /speaking, /market and /exams the document height was unchanged (1746->1746, 2369->2369, 1942->1942) and maxScroll was unchanged, and on /reading, /listening a clamp would have landed at 364/406 rather than 0.
issues.notTheCause: Not the shared student layout's scroll-to-top effect, which is keyed on [pathname] and cannot fire without a route change; and not a scrollTo call in any of the catalog pages (grep found none).
issues.risk: A learner filtering a long catalog is thrown back to the top on every click, so the results they filtered for are off screen.
issues.recommendedNextPhase: UI/UX remediation phase; root-cause the remount that discards scroll position.

issues.title: Listening exercise page pushes repeated history entries, trapping Back
issues.evidence: Navigating /listening -> /listening/1 added 5 history entries and emitted 13 main-frame navigation events all to /listening/1. Two consecutive Back presses both stayed on /listening/1 and never returned to /listening.
issues.risk: Browser Back does not leave the exercise; the learner must press Back repeatedly to escape.
issues.recommendedNextPhase: UI/UX remediation phase; replace repeated pushes with replace-state for in-exercise state sync.

issues.title: Back restores list scroll position inconsistently
issues.evidence: Back from a detail page returned to the correct list on /courses, /exams and /flashcard, but only /courses restored the scroll offset (left at 420, returned at 420). /exams and /flashcard returned at scrollY 0 after leaving at 800 and 605.
issues.risk: Learners lose their place in long catalogs on some surfaces but not others.
issues.recommendedNextPhase: UI/UX remediation phase; make the Back restoration policy uniform.

issues.title: Grammar is entirely invisible to learners
issues.evidence: GET /grammar/topics returns 0 items for FREE, PLUS and PRO. DB holds 12 topics and 60 questions, every topic publicationStatus=DRAFT. Browser: /grammar renders a correct zero-content state with a human-readable message and no error.
issues.notRecoveryLoss: Content exists and is intact; only publication state withholds it.
issues.risk: A whole advertised skill has no learner content.
issues.recommendedNextPhase: Content-owner decision to publish; not a code fix.

issues.title: Arena never reads the learner's currency balance before queueing
issues.evidence: src/app/(student)/arena/page.tsx has no reference to totalBanh/balance; stake buttons are disabled only while isSearching. A QA learner with 0 Banh Mi can select a stake and press 'Tim doi thu ngay', and only then is refused.
issues.mitigation: The refusal itself is well handled: 'Ban khong du 50 Banh Mi de tham gia muc cuoc nay!' with no raw JSON, no stack trace, no stuck spinner, and the CTA stays usable.
issues.securityImpact: none - the server enforces the stake correctly

issues.title: UI stake ladder omits the lowest server-allowed stake
issues.evidence: arena.gateway.ts allowedStakes=[10,20,50,100]; arena/page.tsx STAKES=[20,50,100]. Browser confirms 3 stake buttons.

issues.title: Backend formatting debt
issues.evidence: Resolved during the backup phase: npm run lint:check now exits 0. Kept for traceability.

mediaClassificationSummary.whyAmbiguous: Every remaining ambiguous reference is an image whose visual content cannot be tied to its prompt from database evidence alone. This is a limit of a read-only audit, not a recovery gap: zero required media is missing (SEMANTIC_MISMATCH=0). Closing them needs visual inspection of each image against its prompt.
